job_description.summary: Rohde & Schwarz is seeking a Software Application Development Engineer for its New Delhi office. The position involves developing and integrating software features using established coding standards, adopting engineering processes and quality practices, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, improving existing codebases through refactoring and documentation, translating customer requirements into Software Design Documents, and delivering milestones while participating in periodic reviews. The stated qualifications include C++, Python, object-oriented programming, GUI development, debugging, and unit testing, with at least three years of professional experience.
responsibilities: Adopt and follow the organization's engineering processes, quality standards, and development environment.
Design, implement, and integrate software solutions and features in accordance with coding standards and best practices.
Collaborate with internal development teams and internal and external customers.
Meet software quality targets and ensure that release quality gates are satisfied.
Refactor and document existing code to improve maintainability and testability.
Capture and map software requirements from internal and external customers and document them in Software Design Documents.
Plan and execute milestones and participate in periodic reviews.
basic_qualifications: BE/BTech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent qualification.
At least three years of professional software development experience.
Solid experience developing graphical user interfaces.
Experience using test frameworks and creating unit tests.
Ability to work independently with a goal-oriented approach.
preferred_qualifications: Experience using API commands when building application GUIs.
Ability to adapt to another programming language.
